concepts.title: Hospitality and the Guest
concepts.definition: Hospitality is the warm, generous bond between host and guest -- shelter, food, entertainment and courteous service -- owed to every traveller; Indian tradition holds the guest as divine, and modern trade has turned that duty into a fast growing industry promising a home away from home.
concepts.formula: hospitality = welcome plus stay plus food plus entertainment plus courteous service
concepts.key_idea: A tourist is anyone who travels and stays temporarily elsewhere, and repeat visits depend on comfort, safety and hygiene.
question_patterns: what is hospitality and why is it significant today
what does Athithi Devo Bhava imply for the service industry
who is a tourist
why is hospitality called a home away from home

solution_steps.explain: guest host relationship expressed through reception, entertainment and warm service

solution_steps.action: link travel growth to industry growth
solution_steps.explain: business, medical, leisure and pilgrimage travel all demand comfortable safe stays

worked_examples.q: Indian tradition holds the guest as what: divine or difficult?

concepts.title: Types of Hospitality Establishments
concepts.definition: Establishments range from the hotel with lodging, meals and services, through the motel with doorstep parking, the lodge offering only sleeping space, the leisure rich resort, to furnished apartments and camps for hikers and adventure seekers.
concepts.formula: establishment ladder -- lodge plus motel plus hotel plus resort plus apartments plus camps
concepts.key_idea: What separates the types is the bundle offered: rooms only, rooms plus parking, or a full vacation experience.
question_patterns: differentiate between a hotel, a motel and a lodge
what makes a resort different from other establishments
who would choose furnished camps and why
what services does a furnished apartment offer guests
name the establishments that provide hospitality services

solution_steps.explain: hotel, motel, lodge, resort, furnished apartment, furnished camp
sleeping only, parking access, full amenities, leisure programming

worked_examples.q: Which establishment offers lodging, meals and services: a hotel or a lodge?

concepts.title: Guest Cycle and Industry Sectors
concepts.definition: The guest cycle tracks one stay through four stages -- pre arrival quoting and reserving, arrival with registration, occupancy with services and security aimed at winning loyalty, and departure with check out, occupancy records and guest history -- while the industry itself divides into front office, food and beverage, meetings and events, entertainment and tourism sectors.
concepts.formula: cycle stages -- pre arrival plus arrival plus occupancy plus departure
concepts.key_idea: Guest history and feedback recorded at departure feed the next pre arrival, closing the loop.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, guest cycle and Fig 17.1 sectors (approx lines 157-212)
question_patterns: name and explain the four stages of the guest cycle

solution_steps.explain: reserve, check in, serve, check out with records
front office, food and beverage, meetings and events, entertainment, tourism

worked_examples.q: Name the guest cycle's first stage: pre-arrival or departure?

concepts.title: Front Office: Services and Staff
concepts.definition: The front office is a hotel's focal point where the guest first meets the organisation -- welcoming, reserving, registering and rooming guests, holding keys, relaying messages, settling bills -- run round the clock by a manager, assistant manager, shift supervisors, cashier, telephone operator, lobby manager, receptionists, bell captain, bellboys and the doorman.
concepts.formula: front office value = first impression plus records plus billing plus coordination
concepts.key_idea: Cold, indifferent service at the desk can undo the work of every other department; the desk runs twenty four hours on rotating shifts.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, front office and Table 17.1 (approx lines 214-295)

solution_steps.explain: greeting, reservation status, registration and rooming, keys, messages, bills
manager schedules and checks arrivals, cashier holds bills, receptionist rooms guests, bell staff moves baggage

worked_examples.q: Which department is the hotel's focal point where the guest first meets it: front office or laundry?

concepts.title: Housekeeping: Functions and Sections
concepts.definition: Housekeeping guards cleanliness, hygiene and the looks of the whole establishment -- guest rooms, public areas, linen and uniform exchange, flowers and gardens, pest control and inter department coordination -- through seven sections from the control desk to the lost and found.
concepts.formula: sections -- control desk plus management plus guestroom brigade plus public area brigade plus linen room plus horticulture plus lost and found
concepts.key_idea: Contract housekeeping has become a business avenue of its own, serving offices and organisations that outsource cleaning.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, housekeeping functions and sections (approx lines 300-368)
question_patterns: what are the prime functions of the housekeeping department

solution_steps.explain: cleaning rooms and public areas, linen and uniforms, flowers and landscape, coordination, pest control
each of the seven sections owns one slice of the work

worked_examples.q: Which department guards cleanliness, hygiene and looks: housekeeping or accounts?

concepts.title: Housekeeping Staffing and Duties
concepts.definition: The department runs on an executive housekeeper steering manpower, money and time, an assistant per shift, a desk control supervisor who trades room status with the front office around the clock, floor supervisors per floor, room attendants and housemen on cleaning, a public area supervisor, florist and linen room supervisor.
concepts.formula: hierarchy -- executive plus assistant plus desk control plus floor supervisors plus attendants plus housemen plus specialists
concepts.key_idea: The desk control supervisor must be reachable twenty four hours because departures, cleaning and handovers never stop.
question_patterns: write the responsibilities of any three housekeeping personnel

worked_examples.q: Who steers manpower, money and time in housekeeping: the executive housekeeper or the chef?

concepts.title: Cleaning Practices, Equipment and Agents
concepts.definition: Cleaning runs on daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal rounds with matching tools -- vacuum cleaners, brushes, brooms, mops, trolleys -- and agents from water, soap and vinegar to ammonia, washing soda, abrasives and polishes, chosen carefully since strong agents can ruin surfaces like wood, marble, granite or vinyl.
concepts.formula: cleaning choice = surface material plus suitable agent plus right tool and schedule
concepts.key_idea: Eco friendly practice now guides the trade: organic cotton sheets, chemical free laundering, biodegradable agents, towel reuse cards and efficient bulbs.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, cleaning practices, agents and eco friendly notes (approx lines 437-458, 518-524)

solution_steps.explain: daily tasks, weekly deeper rounds, monthly and seasonal or spring cleaning
gentle agents for wood and marble, abrasives only where safe

worked_examples.q: Which agents can ruin marble and wood surfaces: strong abrasives or plain water?

concepts.title: Food and Beverage Department
concepts.definition: The food and beverage department sells food and drink through kitchens, banquets, restaurants, room service, stewarding and bars; large kitchens split into butchery, bakery, confectionery, vegetable work, soups, pantry and hot range under an executive chef, deputies and section chefs, while kitchen stewarding guards the cutlery, crockery and glassware and restaurant staff serve the guest.
concepts.formula: outlets -- kitchen plus banquets plus restaurants plus room service plus stewarding plus bars
concepts.key_idea: The chef de cuisine plans and controls kitchen operations; chef de parties supervise sections; stewards wash pots and issue service equipment.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, food and beverage department (approx lines 526-564)

concepts.title: Support Departments and Management Functions
concepts.section: Support Service Departments and Management Functions
concepts.definition: Back office departments -- finance and accounts, engineering, human resources, sales and marketing -- hold the hotel up, while management itself runs through planning, organising, coordinating, staffing, directing, controlling and evaluating resources against the institution's goals.
concepts.formula: management functions -- planning plus organising plus coordinating plus staffing plus directing plus controlling plus evaluating
concepts.key_idea: Smooth functioning means managing man, material and other resources across departments with complex relationships.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, support departments and management functions (approx lines 566-578)
question_patterns: name the back office departments of a hotel

solution_steps.explain: finance, engineering, HR, sales and marketing
from planning through evaluating resources against goals

worked_examples.q: Name one back office department of a hotel: finance and accounts, or the bar?

concepts.title: Careers and Competencies in Hospitality
concepts.definition: The industry hires from operations staff up through supervisors and junior, middle and top management, favouring energetic, educated youth; personal competencies count -- grooming, hygiene, courtesy, fitness, communication, confidence and languages -- and certificate to degree courses in hotel management open housekeeping, front office and event specialisation careers plus entrepreneurship.
concepts.formula: career ladder -- operations plus supervisor plus junior plus middle plus top management
concepts.key_idea: Front office staff must look their best at all times because their appearance projects the establishment's image.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, scope, competencies and careers (approx lines 580-631)

concepts.title: Shift Rotation Arithmetic
concepts.section: Front office: round the clock operation
concepts.definition: A hotel that never closes divides its twenty four working hours into equal duty shifts, so the number of shift rotations each post needs per day is the operating hours divided by the shift length.
concepts.key_idea: With eight hour shifts, every front office and desk control post needs three staff rotations daily.
concepts.textbook_ref: lehe204.txt, front office manager duties and desk control (approx lines 256-262, 414-417)

solution_steps.explain: the quotient counts how many teams hand over each day

concepts.title: Cleaning Schedule Frequency
concepts.definition: Cleaning rounds repeat on a schedule, so the yearly count of any round is its frequency per week multiplied by the weeks in a year -- the arithmetic that shows daily chores tower over seasonal ones.
concepts.key_idea: A once a week deep clean means 52 rounds a year, while seasonal spring cleaning may touch a room only a few times.
question_patterns: a room gets a weekly deep clean; how many such rounds fall in a year
a corridor is polished twice a week; compute the rounds completed in a year

solution_steps.action: multiply the weekly frequency by the weeks in a year
solution_steps.explain: fifty two weeks turn a weekly habit into an annual total
